title: Set 222

sentences.ko: 그 에어프라이어 진짜 매일 쓸 줄 알았거든. 근데 너무 커서 조리대를 반이나 차지해. 그래서 지금은 그냥 돈 아낄 걸 그랬나 싶어.
sentences.text: I really thought I'd use that air fryer every day, but it's so big that it takes up half the counter, so now I kind of wish I'd just kept the money.

alts.text: Figured I'd be using that air fryer every day, but the thing's huge and hogs half the counter, so now I kinda wish I'd just kept the money.
I truly believed that I would use the air fryer every day, but it is so large that it occupies half of the counter, and I now somewhat regret not keeping the money.

sentences.note: **takes up** 는 공간을 차지한다는 뜻이에요. **I kind of wish I'd just** 는 차라리 그냥 ~할 걸 그랬다고 살짝 후회할 때 써요.

sentences.ko: 토요일에 차 타고 호수에 가려고 했는데 주말 내내 비 온대. 그래서 그냥 집에서 피자나 시켜 먹으려고.
sentences.text: We were going to drive up to the lake on Saturday, but they said it's going to rain all weekend, so we're just staying home and ordering pizza instead.

alts.text: So the plan was to drive up to the lake Saturday, but supposedly it's gonna rain all weekend, so we're just gonna stay in and get pizza.
We had planned to drive to the lake on Saturday, but the forecast says it will rain throughout the weekend, so we will remain at home and order pizza instead.

sentences.note: **drive up to** 는 차를 몰고 좀 떨어진 곳까지 간다는 느낌이에요. **they said** 는 일기예보처럼 누가 한 말인지 딱 집지 않고 ~래 할 때 써요.

sentences.ko: 아니야 엄마, 나 진짜 괜찮아. 회사도 별일 없고 밥도 잘 먹어. 응, 목소리 좀 이상한 거 알아. 근데 낮잠 자다 막 깨서 그래, 그게 다야.
sentences.text: No, I'm good, Mom, really. Work's fine, I'm eating, and yeah, I know I sound a little off, but I just woke up from a nap, that's all.

alts.text: Mom, I'm fine, seriously. Work's okay, I'm eating, and yeah, I know I sound kinda weird, but I just woke up from a nap, that's it.
No, I am fine, Mother, truly. Work is going well, I am eating properly, and yes, I realize I sound a little unusual, but I have only just woken from a nap.

sentences.note: **I'm good** 는 괜찮다, 됐다는 뜻으로 걱정이나 권유를 사양할 때 써요. **sound a little off** 는 목소리가 평소랑 좀 다르게 들린다는 말이에요.
sentences.situation: 부모님 안부 전화에서 잘 지낸다고 둘러대기

sentences.ko: 회사 가까이로 이사할까 말까 계속 왔다 갔다 해. 그러면 하루에 한 시간 정도는 아낄 텐데, 거기는 월세가 훨씬 비싸고 친구들이랑 가까이 사는 게 그리울 것 같아.
sentences.text: I keep going back and forth about moving closer to work. I'd save like an hour every day, but rent's a lot higher over there, and I'd miss being close to all my friends.

alts.text: Can't make up my mind about moving closer to work. It'd save me like an hour a day, but rent's way higher there, and I'd miss being near all my friends.
I remain undecided about relocating closer to my workplace. I would save approximately an hour each day, but the rent there is considerably higher, and I would miss living near my friends.

sentences.note: **go back and forth** 는 마음을 못 정하고 이랬다저랬다 한다는 뜻이에요. **I'd miss being close to** 는 ~ 가까이 있는 게 그리울 것 같다는 말이에요.

sentences.ko: 내 폰이 배터리 40퍼센트쯤에서 자꾸 꺼져. 가끔은 통화하는 중에 저 혼자 재부팅되기도 하고. 그래서 배터리 문제인지 폰을 새로 사야 하는 건지 모르겠어.
sentences.text: My phone keeps dying at like forty percent, and sometimes it just restarts by itself in the middle of a call, so I don't know if it's the battery or if I need a new phone.

alts.text: Ugh, my phone dies at like forty percent, and sometimes it just restarts on its own mid-call, so is it the battery or do I need a new phone?
My phone repeatedly shuts down at around forty percent, and occasionally it restarts by itself during a call, so I am not certain whether the battery is at fault or whether I require a new phone.

sentences.note: **keeps dying** 는 배터리가 자꾸 나간다는 뜻이에요. 휴대폰이 꺼질 때 **die** 를 써요. **by itself** 는 저 혼자, 저절로라는 뜻이에요.

reviewed: 1번 casual: 문장 앞의 Honestly는 뜻에 보태는 것 없이 장식으로 붙어 있어서 뺐습니다
2번 casual: So the plan was driving up은 원어민이 잘 안 하는 꼴이라 So the plan was to drive up으로 고쳤습니다
2번 ko: 집에 있으면서 대신 피자나는 군더더기가 겹쳐 번역투라서 그냥 집에서 피자나 시켜 먹으려고로 다듬었습니다
2번 note: drive up to의 up은 실제로 올라간다는 뜻보다 차를 몰고 좀 멀리 간다는 느낌이라 설명을 고쳤습니다
5번 casual: mid call은 mid-call로 붙여 쓰는 것이 맞아 고쳤습니다
